name: pasr-realagent-pilot
status: DRAFT — confirm pins and tasks against the resolved checkouts before the A100 run.
notes: Source-grounded locate/trace/explain tasks on pinned public Python repos. The notebook shallow-clones each repo at its pin, records the resolved commit into the matrix, and runs all four arms. answer_keywords are identifiers expected to be stable near the pin; the executable/reference grader in the notebook supersedes the keyword proxy.

tasks.query: where is the request body and headers assembled before sending
what does the top-level get helper call to actually perform the http request
how are redirects resolved and followed by the session
where does a command group decide which subcommand to invoke
how is a parameter value converted from the raw string on the command line
how does the option parser split short and long flags
where is the modern class decorator that adds slots and init implemented
what builds the generated __init__ method for an attrs class
how does asdict recurse into nested attrs instances and containers
where are all the registered hook implementations actually invoked in order
what happens when a plugin is registered on the manager
how is firstresult handling different from a normal hook call
where is the middleware stack wrapped around the application
how does a routed request reach the endpoint callable
how are streaming responses sent chunk by chunk over asgi
